title: Ned Tries a New Seed
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes eigh, ei, ey.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling landing on top of a wooden bird table scattered with seeds.
Ned the duckling noticing an unfamiliar dark seed among the usual bird seed on the table.
Ned the duckling pecking curiously at the new dark seed.
Ned the duckling jerking back slightly, beak snapping shut on the unexpectedly hard seed.
Ned the duckling tapping the hard seed firmly on the wooden surface of the table.
A small crack appearing in the hard shell of the seed.
The cracked seed revealing a soft, pale centre inside.
Ned the duckling happily pecking at the soft inside of the seed.
Ned the duckling moving on to crack open a second hard seed, smiling.
Ned the duckling standing contentedly on the bird table, several cracked seed shells around him.
